# White Noise

A white noise process is defined as

$$
Y_t \sim WN(0,\sigma^2)
$$

Properties:

1. \(E(Y_t)=0\)
2. \(Var(Y_t)=\sigma^2\)
3. \(Cov(Y_t,Y_{t-k})=0\)


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
plot.ts(y)
```
